_comment: Common integration reporting envelope for cross-track resource comparison.
PURPOSE: make total resources comparable and additive across tracks WITHOUT
replacing any track's internal accounting. Native units stay authoritative;
this is a reporting layer, not a mandate.
STATUS: schema defined 2026-09-03, mappings incomplete. Populating it is an
explicit precondition for ccs/EXP-I1 and ccs/EXP-U1.
A dimension marked 'unmapped' is not a gap in a track's rigour - it usually
means that track has no such resource. 'incommensurable' is the serious case:
the quantity exists but cannot be expressed in the common unit without an
arbitrary exchange rate, and it BLOCKS integration until resolved.
Every track must declare EVERY dimension as exactly one of mapped, unmapped or incommensurable. An undeclared dimension is an unexamined one, and the validator rejects it.

dimensions.definition: Total parameters held, including cold storage for retired or inactive state.
Parameters that can influence a forward pass at a given moment.
dimensions.additive_note: Peak and mean must be reported separately; summing across tracks is meaningless without a shared notion of simultaneity.

dimensions.definition: Parameter elements exposed to optimizer writes over the run.
Compute spent on adaptation or training updates.
Compute whose output can change a routing, promotion, rollback or release decision. Never folded into post-hoc evaluation cost.
Compute spent moving state between timescales, including merges and offline replay.
Episodic, replay or evidence storage held, including cold storage.
Evidence, replay or log records read, charged per record scanned.
Measured runtime, reported where hardware is comparable.
dimensions.additive_note: Reported, never used as a primary matched budget across tracks on different hardware.

dimensions.definition: Delay between evidence availability and outward release. COMMIT_EXTERNAL only.
dimensions.additive_note: A cost borne by an interlocutor, not by the system. See the open problem below.

dimensions.definition: Cost of an outward action, including asking a question or taking an irreversible step. COMMIT_EXTERNAL only.
dimensions.additive_note: No track has defined this yet. Recorded so it is not forgotten when adaptive-commitment is scaffolded.

state-promotion.native_unit: write unit = number of elements in the fast-state parameter subset

mapped.write_ops: write units x fast-subset element count; hard ceiling nominally 2T for T online events

plasticity-routing.native_unit: unified cost table with one hard write ceiling shared by every arm

mapped.compute_decision: router decision compute, reported separately (3.91% of total for LEARNED, 0.19% for HEURISTIC in dev calibration)
mapped.store_bytes: episodic substrate footprint, which grows with entries
mapped.store_reads: episodic retrieval charged per entry scanned

plasticity-routing.note: This track already folds storage, write and compute into ONE scalar objective via lambda weights. That is a solved version of the envelope problem inside one track, and the exchange rates it chose are a candidate starting point - but they were calibrated for SDW-1 and are not automatically transferable.

modular-consolidation.native_unit: capacity accounting: param_total, param_active, param_peak, storage_total, total_algorithmic_flops

mapped.param_capacity_stored: param_total and storage_total, including cold storage for retired modules
mapped.compute_decision: routing decision compute, included in total_algorithmic_flops

lifetime-integrity.native_unit: evidence reads against a capped log, plus maintenance ops

mapped.store_reads: evidence reads, charged per record scanned against a shared ceiling

lifetime-integrity.note: Architecture-agnostic by design, so parameter-denominated dimensions may remain permanently unmapped for this track. That is a property of the benchmark, not a defect.

adaptive-commitment.native_unit: not yet defined - repository does not exist
adaptive-commitment.note: Recorded before the repository exists so that it is scaffolded with the envelope in view. Its two native costs have no counterpart in any other track.

open_problems.title: No shared exchange rate between internal and external commitment costs
open_problems.detail: COMMIT_INTERNAL costs parameters, writes and interference. COMMIT_EXTERNAL costs latency, intervention and consequence. Comparing them at 'matched total budget' requires an exchange rate that no track has defined and that may not exist non-arbitrarily. This is recorded as the fourth falsifier of CCS-C12: if the cost structures are genuinely incommensurable, the unification claim fails on measurement grounds even if a shared mechanism is buildable.

open_problems.title: param_capacity_active is not additive across tracks
open_problems.detail: Two tracks each holding N active parameters do not constitute a 2N-active-parameter system unless they are active simultaneously. Peak and mean must be reported separately and an integration total must state its simultaneity assumption explicitly.

open_problems.title: Nobody owns the envelope
open_problems.detail: Each track's native accounting is authoritative and correct for its own purposes. Populating and maintaining the mapping is umbrella work, but reconciling a disagreement about what a dimension means would require agreement across tracks, and the umbrella cannot direct that. Unowned as of 2026-09-03.
